  • Sanity Retest of Previous Blocker Findings:
    • Initial testing returned generic HTTP 500 Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again later. when requesting a panorama share link for moderation 3544123 (both with real pano ID and invalid pano ID).
    • Root Cause Identified: Similar to issue #849, the column 0_moderation.publish_account was stored as an empty string '' (not NULL). In the legacy helper GoogleStreetViewClass::getPublishEmailByModerationID, an untyped generic \Exception("Publish account not found", 409) was thrown. Because untyped exceptions bypassed ToursDomainException and fell into catch (\Throwable), ResponseEnvelopeHelper::errorResponseFromThrowable mapped it directly to generic HTTP 500. if ($email === '') {
    throw new AccountNotConnectedException();
}
      • AccountNotConnectedException maps to domain code TOURS.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED with HTTP 401 Unauthorized (Not connected account), cleanly indicating the missing publish account without a 500 crash.
      • If Google Street View returns null for the panorama share link, it throws typed ShareLinkNotFoundException mapping to domain code TOURS.SV_SHARE_LINK_NOT_FOUND with HTTP 404 Not Found (messages.tours.share_link_not_found).
      • Full migration to 100% strict Domain-Based ADR architecture with complete removal of legacy GoogleStreetViewClass.php.

      • InvalidImageOrientationException maps to domain code STITCHING.INVALID_IMAGE_ORIENTATION.
      • StitchingExceptionHttpMapper maps STITCHING.INVALID_IMAGE_ORIENTATION to HTTP 409 Conflict with message:

issues.display_title: Issue #2074: feat(feature-flags): API that returns the SSO switch per environment (dev / live)
issues.main_description_html:
Background

The Single Sign-On (SSO) switch added in GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4388 is a dashboard build setting (REACT_APP_KEYCLOAK_AUTH_ENABLED). Turning SSO on or off needs a dashboard rebuild and deploy, and the dev and live dashboards can't be switched separately. That approach is now outdated.

Goal

The API tells the dashboard whether SSO is on. The switch is stored in Redis, so it can be changed without a deploy, separately for dev and live.

Scope

  • GET /v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live: works without login and returns the switch in the standard response format (not encrypted): { "statusCode": 200, "data": { "messages": "...", "env": "dev", "keycloak_auth": true } }
    • Without env, the API answers for live. Any value other than dev or live is rejected (422).
  • The switch is read from Redis (Toronto), with one key per environment:
    • feature_flags:dev:keycloak_auth
    • feature_flags:live:keycloak_auth
    • 1 (or true) means on, 0 means off. To change it, set the value (SET <key> 1 / SET <key> 0); keys are not deleted. A missing key counts as off.
  • There is only one API (production) and one Redis for both dev and live, which is why the dashboard has to say which environment it is.
  • If Redis can't be read, the API returns an error (500). The dashboard then shows an error with a "Try Again" button.
  • Only the SSO switch for now. The response can carry more switches later.

Out of Scope

  • A screen or API for changing the switch (it is set directly in Redis for now).
  • Moving maintenance mode to the API.
  • Dashboard changes (GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4395).

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: With feature_flags:live:keycloak_auth set to 1, GET /v1/feature-flags returns keycloak_auth: true. With 0 it returns false.
  • AC-002: ?env=dev reads only the dev key. Changing the dev key does not change the live answer, and vice versa.
  • AC-003: A missing key returns keycloak_auth: false.
  • AC-004: An env other than dev or live returns 422.
  • AC-005: The endpoint works without logging in.
  • AC-006: If Redis can't be read, the response is 500 with the standard error body.
  • AC-007: Unit tests cover AC-001 – AC-006.

Setup before release

  • SET feature_flags:dev:keycloak_auth 0
  • SET feature_flags:live:keycloak_auth 0

Related

  • GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4388: SSO switch as a build setting (outdated by this task)
  • GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4395: dashboard reads the switch from this API

Result

    • Without env the API answers for live; any other value is rejected with 422. If Redis can't be read, the response is 500.
  • To turn SSO on or off: SET feature_flags:<dev|live>:keycloak_auth 1 (on) or 0 (off). It takes effect on the dashboard's next page load, no deploy needed.
